title: edikt plan evaluation state
description: Machine-local evaluation state for a plan (.edikt/state/plan-eval/PLAN-<slug>-eval.json). Holds the per-criterion history the pre-v0.6.0 criteria sidecar used to carry (status, fail_count, fail_reason, block_reason, last_evaluated). Written by the in-session evaluator and templates/hooks/phase-end-detector.sh; read by templates/hooks/post-compact.sh. Never read by `bin/edikt verify` — the criteria sidecar (plan-criteria.v1.schema.json) stays spec-only. JSON, not YAML: hooks are POSIX bash with stdlib-only Python, so json.load/json.dump is the only structured read-modify-write they can do. State entries carry state only — statement/verify live in the criteria sidecar, matched by id. .edikt/state/ is gitignored: this history is machine-local; the durable committed record is the verdict JSONs under {paths.plans}/verdicts/.

plan.description: Plan identifier, matching the criteria sidecar's plan field.

last_evaluated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent evaluation across all phases, or null before the first.

attempt.description: N/M attempt counter mirroring the plan progress table, e.g. "2/5".
